prompt:
Review one candidate time core [2170,2184) in entity machine-3-3.
Route reason: dino_proposal. dino_proposal uses the original DINO spike/height and seasonal evidence. dino_partial_tail_review covers a final partial window without DINO scores (seasonal scores may exist). unscored_tail_review covers samples beyond the saved Stage1 output. Both tail routes are forced reviews, NOT DINO anomaly claims. Percentile scores are NOT anomaly probabilities. The 224-tick display is [2065,2289); its axes show tile-relative ticks. The candidate is [105,119) on these axes, end excluded. No candidate boundary is drawn; orange marks each local zoom, not the candidate. Context outside the candidate is context only. Other proposals may appear anywhere in the display; a change outside the candidate is not a reason to accept this candidate. If location or association is unclear, respond uncertain.
The heatmap shows all 38 channels. Detailed channels on this page: [9, 10, 12, 11, 3, 29]. Round 0, page 1/1. Judge event validity IN THE CORE separately from which displayed channels react. A channel can visibly spike in a normal repeating state. Selecting a channel alone does not establish an anomalous event. Do not infer root causes or causal direction.
Black is observed, dashed blue the retrieved normal-train median. A blue band means pre-focus context is supported; a grey/LOW SUPPORT band means poor or unstable support. Neither is a calibrated normality boundary. A flat median may erase ordinary spikes. Inspect full traces, local changes and pre/post behavior. Display-local-change focus is only a viewer aid; Stage1 peak focus preserves the source detector's location.
